posts.t:
#SeaKraken win 5-3 over UTA

🥅 Grubauer - so so good. Again.
🏒 Samo - his second GWG this season (and 2nd in 2 GP)
⚡️ Two PPGs for each team
🏒 Kraken bend but don't break- play UTA as even as they ever have - won 67% of puck battles
🏒 Two point nights for Eberle and Montour
Lane Lambert says Montour is a game time decision for #SeaKraken
Per #SeaKraken defenseman Brandon Montour will not play tonight due to a lower-body injury. He is listed as day-to-day.

#SeaKraken  fall 4-3 in OT to TBL

🥅 Earn a valuable point against a tough opponent
🥅 Grubauer had same top tier saves (again!)
🏒 Beniers gets to 200 points on the tying goal to force OT
🏒 Both sides of special teams come up big
🏒 Gaudreau line scores (again!)
🏥 Montour leaves the game in P2 (LB)
Per #SeaKraken PR, Brandon Montour (lower body) will not return to tonight's game
